title: Governed Character Intelligence Orchestrator
objective: Implement governed character-intelligence orchestration for permitted dynamic context assembly, grounded knowledge, scoped memory projections, speech/voice presentation, explainable prompt/context inspection, model/provider routing and structured tool/action proposals while preserving strict Action/Event capability enforcement and valid no-AI/fake-provider paths.

scope.purpose: Provide Multiversal-native NPC/character intelligence orchestration without granting AI unrestricted NPC/GM authority or replacing Character, Action/Event, knowledge, memory, speech/voice or provider owner contracts.
scope.completion_gate: Representative governed character-intelligence inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable bounded context, routing and structured proposal plans with strict capability/owner checks and valid provider-off fallback while invalid authority/context/tool/action states fail closed and no unrestricted NPC/GM authority is created.

selection_boundaries: Owner Continue on 2026-09-16 governed-started PCA-11; implementation authority is limited to work/pca-11-governed-character-intelligence-orchestrator.
PCA-01..10 remain completed foundations and must be composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.

CNI-06 retains Character-aware narrative branching over explicit permission-filtered owner projections; PCA-11 may consume declared claims but may not infer unsupported traits, fetch hidden owner truth or create Character state.

CNI-07 retains NPC continuity/relationship/callback binding; PCA-11 may consume stable NPC/relationship/reputation/timeline projections but may not create or mutate NPC, Relationship, Reputation or timeline truth or execute callbacks.

MIB-15 retains visibility-first authorized-context assembly, provider abstraction, deterministic fake/disabled provider behavior and candidate/provenance semantics; PCA-11 may route through those prepared paths but may not select a production provider, require network access, activate paid execution or persist hidden/raw provider state.

A11 capability state cannot widen canonical permissions or create authority; only already-enabled permitted capability records may be represented. Contextual AI actions remain directMutationAllowed=false and retain manual fallback.

Action/Event/APM/SMB-12 and owning Character/NPC/GM domains retain AI-action and canonical mutation authority; PCA-11 may prepare structured proposals only and cannot grant unrestricted NPC/GM actions or dispatch canonical mutations.

Knowledge and memory inputs are scoped owner projections with explicit provenance; PCA-11 creates no hidden knowledge base, memory ledger or inferred recollection. Speech/voice is presentation preparation only and does not replace AAI/DWC/PCA-08 authority.
No-AI and deterministic fake-provider paths remain valid blocking-workflow fallbacks.
PCA-12+, MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: Create the focused PCA-11 acceptance and validation profile only, establish causal exact-head RED, then implement the minimum deterministic governed character-intelligence orchestration contract preserving CNI/MIB-15/A11/Action-Event owner authority.
